newsitem.title: CHINA: Investor AB to invest in HK United Pac.
newsitem.headline: Investor AB to invest in HK United Pac.

text.p: A subsidiary of Swedish investment group Investor AB will acquire an eight percent stake in United Pacific Industries Ltd for HK$53.63 million, the Hong Kong firm said on Wednesday.
The Hong Kong-based manufacturer will issue 35.75 million new share to Investor AB's investment vehicle at HK$1.50 each, United Pacific said in a statement.
The price represents a premium of 23 percent to the average share price of HK$1.22, over the last six months and a premium of 7.1 percent over the share price of HK$1.40 on the last trading day.

Investor AB has the option to acquire more new shares to increase its total interest to up to 12 percent of the enlarged issued share capital by Setpember 15 and obtain a seat on the United Pacific board.
The exercise price of the option shares would be HK$1.55 each, the statement said.
The Hong Kong company said it will use proceeds from the new share issue to reduce its gearing.
It intends to repay by March 31, 1998 a HK$150 million loan recently raised to finance its acquistion of Hong Kong Toy Centre International Ltd, the firm said.
